reply: ChEMBL lists 5 approved drugs that block Complement C5. The genetic prediction is the same for all of them; the label and report checks are per drug, so here is **Eculizumab** (first approved 2007), the longest on the market. **Eculizumab** lowers the activity of **Complement C5** (C5) (ChEMBL action type INHIBITOR).
